criteria.statement: A pre-seeded verified store renders the worker list and job or operation timeline without a network gate or loading spinner.
Live worker-state and operation events update their view; older addressable events cannot regress state and tombstones remove deleted worker records.
Any number of worker-authored advertisements use one open-author ref-counted REQ, and seen-event memory is bounded.
Navigating away and back does not trigger worker REST reads or a second per-worker subscription.
